data.key: Sorcerer Bonus Spell L9 ~ Wail of the Banshee
data.name: Wail of the Banshee
data.description: When you cast this spell, you emit a terrible, soul-chilling scream that possibly kills creatures that hear it [except for yourself]. The spell affects up to one creature per caster level, inflicting 10 points of damage per caster level. Creatures closest to the point of origin are affected first.|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
